content.title: A Body of Doctrinal Divinity (1769)
content.author: John Gill
content.note: The systematic theology of the leading English Baptist of the eighteenth century, a strict Calvinist. For one historic Baptist position on election, the covenants and the atonement, set beside other Baptist positions where Baptists differ.
